text: 你注意到，仔细查看这些物品的人不止你一个。那名僧侣似乎也在仔细端详较为奇特的物品，而先前那两名穿深色西装的绅士似乎看中了那尊古怪的偶像。除此之外，还有其他宾客在桌边走动，偶尔停下来仔细看某件物品。宾客很多，投出的报价也不少。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 81
text: You notice that you’re not the only one looking over the items with such interest. The monk appears to be closely scrutinizing the stranger items as well, and the dark-suited gentlemen from earlier seem to have taken a liking to the curious idol. Apart from this, various other guests wander around the tables, occasionally fixing on one in particular. There are many guests and a fair number of bids being placed.
